__base__.name: aops
__base__.description: AcademicOps core framework — combining task/work-unit modules, strategic planning, task-lifecycle, dispatch, session lifecycle, and swappable technology-specific academic skills.

pkb_mcp_url.title: PKB MCP Server URL
pkb_mcp_url.description: URL of your academicOps PKB MCP server (Streamable HTTP), e.g. http://services-new.stoat-musical.ts.net:8020/mcp. Supplied to the pkb MCP server as PKB_MCP_URL.

bot_gh_token.title: GitHub Bot Token
bot_gh_token.description: GitHub personal access token for automated git/gh operations. Overrides or populates AOPS_BOT_GH_TOKEN.

src_dir.title: Source Root Directory
src_dir.description: Default root path for discovering project repositories (AOPS_SRC_DIR). Defaults to ~/src.

sessions_dir.title: Sessions Registry Path
sessions_dir.description: Path to local sessions registry repository (AOPS_SESSIONS). Defaults to $POLECAT_HOME/sessions.
